learning_outcomes.text: Students will be able to create simple console and more complex GUI (Windows Forms) programs in C#.

syllabus_topics: Architecture .NET, introduction to language C#, assembly, name spaces
Value data types - primitive data types, structures, enumerated type
Reference data types - classes, arrays (regular, irregular)
Reference data types - delegates (definition and use of anonymous method, lambda expression), interface
Statements - basic construction, decision-making, cycles, jumps etc.
Classes - declaration, data files, attributes, methods
Classes - inheritance, polymorphism, abstract, static, partial classes
Interface - declaration, implicit and explicit implementation, basic library interfaces, iterators
Exceptions - throwing and catching exceptions, operator overloading
Files, streams, inputs and outputs, object serialization
Genericity - constraints of type parameters, covariance and contravariance of type parameters, Windows Forms - GUI toolkit
assessment_rules: A condition for the award of credit is the completion of 9 assignments in the exercises. During the examination period, at least 2 dates for remedial credit are implemented; to obtain remedial credit, it is necessary to additionally fulfil all the conditions for obtaining regular credit and to fulfill practical assignment within the time limit (1:30 hours) at the remedial date. In order to pass the examination, it is necessary to work out a given complex assignment within a given time limit (2:30 hours). The score of at least 60 % is required to pass the examination (grade E).
bibliography: Troelsen, Andrew W.; Japikse Philip. Pro C# 10 with .NET 6. Berkeley, 2022. ISBN 978-1-4842-7868-0.
